desc:
🏡 DECORATE YOUR DREAM HOME 🏡
Build the cutest home on the street with 4,500+ pieces of furniture and decor in themed sets: Cosy, Castle, Wizard, Mochi, Modern and more!

🎨 MAKE IT YOURS 🎨
Recolour almost everything: furniture, wallpapers, floors, doors, fences and more. Knock down walls for open-plan rooms, or build from scratch on a Free Build Plot.

🏰 UPGRADE YOUR HOME 🏰
Grow your little house into a mansion, or move into a Castle, a Mochi House or a Houseboat. Save homes in slots and swap any time!

🐾 PETS 🐾
Adopt pets, dress them up and level them up, then ride or fly some of them. Hunt for secret and limited pets!

💸 EARN COINS 💸
Work at the Car Wash and Boba Shop, go fishing, paint at the Colouring Corner and claim Daily Rewards. Show off your home for Robux donations!

👫 BETTER WITH FRIENDS 👫
Trade pets, visit homes and earn up to 4x coins together!

🏆 CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS 🏆
Most Favourited, Most Time Played, Most Robux Earned or Donated
